Material Planning & Control · Develop and manage short-term & long-term material plans aligned with production targets. · Ensure timely availability of raw materials (HR coils, chemicals, consumables, zinc, paints, packing material, etc.). · Optimize inventory levels to avoid stock-outs or excess inventory. · Maintain safety stock norms and monitor consumption trends. B. Production Coordination · Align material plans with daily/weekly/monthly production schedules. · Coordinate with Production, Quality, and Maintenance for planning accuracy. · Manage material allocation for CR, GAL, CCL, Slitting, CTL, and Service Centre operations. C. Supply Chain & Vendor Coordination · Coordinate with Procurement for timely ordering and follow-up. · Monitor supplier performance in terms of delivery timelines and quality. · Liaise with logistics for inbound and outbound material planning. D. Inventory & Warehouse Management · Ensure accurate GRN posting, stock reconciliation, and cycle counting. · Drive continuous improvement in warehouse operations for better space utilization. · Maintain FIFO/FEFO discipline across stores. E. Cost Optimization · Identify opportunities to reduce inventory carrying costs. · Minimize demurrage, detention, and transportation inefficiencies. · Support strategic sourcing decisions with data-driven insights. F. Systems, Data & Reporting · Oversee SAP/ERP-based planning, MRP runs, and inventory dashboards. · Publish daily, weekly, and monthly material planning reports. · Lead digital initiatives like automated planning tools, consumption analytics, etc. G. Compliance & Governance · Ensure adherence to internal controls, audit norms, and safety standards. · Drive compliance with material handling, storage safety, and documentation procedures. H. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) · Raw material availability % · Inventory Turns / Days of inventory · Stock-out incidents · Material accuracy (SAP vs physical) · Forecast accuracy · Demurrage & detention cost · OTIF (On-Time In-Full) material supply · Cost savings through planning optimization Open positions: 1
